faq_description: Straight answers about inputs, permissions, supported browsers, and control.
faq_answer_hardware: A current desktop or laptop browser is enough. A built-in or external webcam is only needed for head control; keyboard and mouse remain available. No specialist hardware is required.
faq_answer_camera: No. Camera access is optional and skippable. Keyboard, mouse, voice, and text paths remain available; head control needs camera permission.
faq_answer_storage: Raw camera frames are processed in the browser for face landmarks. Aksa does not store or transmit raw frames for control.
faq_answer_browsers: Current Chrome and Edge are the primary full-support targets. Safari support is limited by speech-recognition behavior, while Firefox uses text instead of browser speech recognition. Mobile layout is usable, but head control is not a supported mobile input.
faq_question_changes: Can Aksa change files without permission?
faq_answer_changes: Read-only actions may run without confirmation. Writes, moves, renames, drafts, shares, and sends require a preview and approval according to scope. Dwell or a facial gesture alone cannot approve a consequential action.
faq_question_stop_undo: Can I stop or undo a task?
faq_answer_stop_undo: Running tasks expose cancellation. Completed reversible actions expose Undo when genuinely supported. Aksa reports partial completion honestly, and Undo availability depends on the action.
faq_answer_offline: Calibration drafts or temporary client state may persist locally where documented. AI, search, and Google integrations require a network connection; Aksa does not run agent tasks offline.
faq_answer_tools: Aksa works with Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Gmail reading and draft creation, and grounded web search. New capabilities are added progressively.
